test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At a function, the chief guest was accompanied by some people, and all were sitting in the audience gallery facing towards the west. P sits second to the left of the chief guest, Q sits fourth to the right of P. The number of people sitting to the right of Q is exactly one less than the number of people sitting to the left of Q. No one sits to the left of P. How many total people were sitting in the audience gallery?
solution:
Given: The persons were sitting in the audience gallery facing towards the west.

1) No one sits to the left of P.

2) P sits second to the left of the chief guest.

3) Q sits fourth to the right of P.

4) The number of people sitting to the right of Q is exactly one less than the number of people sitting to the left of Q. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70b63d209e52a09a24e9c77c321e0c6220443b2a9dee18d41bda73435b92593b.png] 

There are total** 8 **people sitting in the audience gallery.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
